nodes.description: A CTCF-associated upstream silencer restrains LMNB1 expression through chromatin looping and PRC2 recruitment. Silencer activity is supported by CRISPR deletion and reporter assays in mouse oligodendrocyte-lineage cells. Human upstream deletions remove the relevant interval, whereas the inverted duplication retains silencer sequence but is predicted to disrupt its regulatory contact. Their proposed convergence is loss of silencer control, not physical loss of the element in every allele. The human oligodendrocyte mechanism remains an extrapolation from model experiments and human genotype comparisons.
